name: circular-precondition
given: two require() calls on computed paths — one driven by a request parameter, one by an operator-owned plugin directory
rationale: The plugin loader is circular: controlling what it loads requires write access to an operator-owned directory, which already IS code execution on the host. It must be ruled out as precondition_subsumes rather than filed as a low-severity RCE. The formatter loader next to it is a real finding, so a run that reports neither has not passed.
